messages:
anya_cs: Quick heads-up — Legal pushed an update to our beta privacy terms that requires explicit re-consent from active preview customers. We also need to turn on SSO for orgs who requested it. Can CS + Sales coordinate a reconsent + enablement plan for Cohort D (Wave 3)?

jamal_success: Ack. Do we have the updated email copy and a list of impacted accounts?

anya_cs: I pasted draft copy below and attached a CSV in my note (see ticket). Short version: 1) Send reconsent email with one-click acknowledge link 2) Offer 15-30m SSO enablement session 3) If account declines SSO, flag renewal risk and offer alternative compliance controls.

maria_onboard: I can run enablement sessions next Tue/Thu 2–4pm PST. Please send the calendar invites + point me to the SSO onboarding doc. Need list of orgs that currently fail SSO onboarding so I can prioritize. :calendar:

patrick_sales: A few customers told me they'll push back on forced SSO — biggest concern is timing during their audit window. Can we make SSO opt-in but require reconsent for terms? I want to avoid churn.

nora_pm: We're aiming for reconsent + optional SSO in Wave 3 to minimize churn. Product can keep the old auth path for 30 days after the notice, but we need CS to capture who will delay SSO and why.

anya_cs: Draft email subject: "Action required: Updated Preview Terms and SSO option for Redwood Inference preview" Body CTA: "Acknowledge updated terms" + "Request SSO session". Draft copy (short):

```
Hi {FirstName},

We updated our Preview Terms to improve data protections. Please review and acknowledge by clicking the button below. If you'd like SSO enabled for your org, request an enablement slot and we'll schedule a short session to walk through setup.

Acknowledge terms | Request SSO session

Thanks,
Redwood Success Team
```

jamal_success: Looks good. Can we add a line about "no data access changes" and a contact for compliance questions?

anya_cs: Yes — will update. Also: Maria, I'll DM the failing SSO list (10 orgs). Patrick — can you triage top-3 renewal-risk customers so we avoid surprises?

patrick_sales: On it. I'll follow up with notes and flag any customers who need executive outreach.

maria_onboard: Got the list. I'll create a shared calendar and a short enablement checklist for the sessions:
- Verify IdP metadata
- Create SCIM (if requested)
- Test SP-initiated login
- Confirm admin contact

cs_bot: [automated] Created ticket CS-4321: "Wave 3 reconsent + SSO enablement" and attached anya_cs/SSO-failures.csv.

anya_cs: Team asks/next steps: 1) Jamal — finalize email copy with added compliance line by EOD. 2) Patrick — provide top-3 risk list by EOD. 3) Maria — schedule enablement slots and share calendar by tomorrow morning. 4) I'll start the email send in small batches (50/day) until we confirm delivery metrics.

jamal_success: Will update copy. :white_check_mark:

patrick_sales: Sending risk list now.

maria_onboard: Calendar shared + first two slots reserved. Starting invites to org admins after copy is finalized.

anya_cs: Thanks. If anyone sees a legal/regulatory red flag during a call, @ me immediately. We'll track reconsent status in the ticket and escalate renewal risks to renewals@redwood. :mag_right: :thumbsup:

patrick_sales: FYI — one customer asked for a recording of the SSO walkthrough. Can we record sessions and store in the previews drive?

maria_onboard: Yep — will record and upload notes.

cs_bot: [automated reminder] Follow-up check in 72h for outstanding reconsent responses.

anya_cs: Closing loop here — thanks team. I'll post a short status update in #customer-success after the first 100 emails send.

patrick_sales: Great, thank you all.

jamal_success: 👍
